## 1- new_umap_plot for all cells

```{r}
##> input is seurat
load("R3_4.1_cleaned_seurat_0.7_ct_integrated.Rdata") # cleaned_0.7_ct
cleaned_0.7_ct-> selected_obj

#> define the color
library(scales)
library(ggsci)

mycolor<-pal_igv("default", alpha = 0.8)(22)
show_col(mycolor)

mycolor= c(
"BAS-I"="#6BD76BCC",
"BAS-II"="#749B58CC"  ,
"BAS-III"="#CDDEB7CC",
"BAS-IV"="#466983CC" ,
"BAS-V"="#5DB1DDCC",
"SPN-I"= "#924822CC",
"SPN-II"= "#D58F5CCC",
"SPN-III"= "#E4AF69CC",
"SPN-IV"= "#F0E685CC" ,
"GRN-I"= "#AE1F63CC",
"GRN-II"= "#802268CC",
"GRN-III"= "#D595A7CC",
"Fib"= "#CE3D32CC",
"MEL" = "#5050FFCC",
"MC/TD"= "#7A65A5CC",
"LC" = "#C75127CC",
"Endo" = "#3B1B53CC",
"Unknown1" ="darkgrey",
"Unknown2" ="darkgrey")

# reorder the cell types
selected_obj$cell_type_0.7 <- factor(x = selected_obj$cell_type_0.7, levels = c(
"BAS-I",
"BAS-II",
"BAS-III",
"BAS-IV",
"BAS-V",
"SPN-I",
"SPN-II",
"SPN-III",
"SPN-IV" ,
"GRN-I",
"GRN-II",
"GRN-III",
"Fib",
"MEL",
"MC/TD",
"LC",
"Endo",
"Unknown1",
"Unknown2"))
```

### 1.1- plot_all cells with anno

```{r}
p1<-CellDimPlot(selected_obj, 
            palcolor = mycolor , # customize the cell color
            label = TRUE, # Add number
            label_insitu = TRUE, # add cell type name
            pt.size = 0.7, # define the point size
            group.by = "cell_type_0.7", 
            reduction = "UMAP",
            theme_use = "theme_blank")

ggsave(p1,filename = "R9_1.1_all_cells_umap.pdf",width = 12, height =6)
```

![](images/Screenshot%202024-10-16%20at%2011.47.49%E2%80%AFAM.png){width="371"}

### 1.2- split plot for study

```{r}
# define the color

# reorder the study
levels(selected_obj@meta.data$study)

		# Reorder the factor levels based on your desired order
selected_obj@meta.data$study <- factor(selected_obj@meta.data$study, 
                                       levels = c("FsEpi", 
                                                  "FibHSE", 
                                                  "PmtHEE"))


p1<-CellDimPlot(selected_obj, 
            palcolor = mycolor, # customize the cell color
            pt.size = 0.7, # define the point size
            group.by = "cell_type_0.7", 
            split.by = "study",
            reduction = "UMAP",
            cells.highlight = TRUE,
            theme_use = "theme_blank",
            legend.position = "right",
            nrow = 1,
            ncol = 3) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20))

ggsave(p1,filename = "R9_1.2_Cell_type_umap_plot_split.pdf",
       width = 15, height =5)
```

![](images/Screenshot%202024-10-16%20at%2011.56.57%E2%80%AFAM.png)

```{r}
## input

load("R4_6.3_KC_only_processed.Rdata")
KC_only_processed-> selected_kc
```

```{r}
cluster_color= c(
"BAS-I"="#6BD76BCC",
"BAS-II"="#749B58CC"  ,
"BAS-III"="#CDDEB7CC",
"BAS-IV"="#466983CC" ,
"BAS-V"="#5DB1DDCC",
"SPN-I"= "#924822CC",
"SPN-II"= "#D58F5CCC",
"SPN-III"= "#E4AF69CC",
"SPN-IV"= "#F0E685CC" ,
"GRN-I"= "#AE1F63CC",
"GRN-II"= "#802268CC",
"GRN-III"= "#D595A7CC")

# reorder the study
levels(selected_kc@meta.data$study)

# Reorder the factor levels based on your desired order
selected_kc@meta.data$study <- factor(selected_kc@meta.data$study, 
                                       levels = c("FsEpi", 
                                                  "FibHSE", 
                                                  "PmtHEE"))

p1<-CellDimPlot(selected_kc, 
            palcolor = cluster_color, # customize the cell color
            pt.size = 0.7, # define the point size
            group.by = "cell_type_0.7", 
            split.by = "study",
            reduction = "UMAP",
            cells.highlight = TRUE,
            theme_use = "theme_blank",
            legend.position = "none",
            nrow = 3,
            ncol = 1) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20))

ggsave(p1,filename = "R9_2_KC_Cell_type_umap_plot_split.pdf",width = 5, height =15)
```
